root.label: BATUK-affected communities march to Kenya Parliament

events.label: BATUK-affected communities march to Kenya Parliament

slots.name: protest date
slots.sentence: On August 12 , survivors, bereaved families and residents from BATUK-affected communities marched to the Parliament in Nairobi, petitioning lawmakers not to ratify the defence agreement until the documented abuses are addressed.

slots.name: average settlement amount
slots.sentence: The Lolldaiga settlement — for a fire that burned for two weeks, scorched 12,000 acres, killed one man and left thousands breathing smoke — averaged under 400 pounds ($530) per claimant.
